title.full: How much CPF you can withdraw

summary.text: From age 55, you can withdraw any amount from your OA if you have set aside your FRS. Otherwise, you can withdraw $5,000.

details.heading: If you have set aside your FRS
details.body: You can withdraw any amount from your Ordinary Account (OA).

details.heading: If you have not set aside your FRS
details.body: You can withdraw $5,000 from your OA. When you withdraw, non-withdrawable OA savings may be transferred to your Retirement Account to help make up your FRS.

details.heading: Check your amount
details.body: You can check the CPF savings you can withdraw from age 55 by logging into your Retirement dashboard.

sources.page_title: How much CPF savings can I withdraw from age 55 to 64?

quotes.text: If you have set aside your Full Retirement Sum (FRS), fully in cash or with a mixture of property and cash:
You can withdraw any amount from your Ordinary Account (OA)
If you have not set aside your FRS: You can withdraw $5,000 from your OA
You can check the CPF savings you can withdraw from age 55 by logging into your Retirement dashboard.
